tei:div.tei:p: 331) ༄༅/ gsang sngags nang gtor gyi ngag 'don bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 332) om̐ ā hūm̐/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gtor snod rgya che bar// gtor ma'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che// phyi nang nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs brgyad// rgyal sras rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang 'dod yon lnga*// sman rag gtor mchod phyi nang gsang mchod sogs// mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i mchod pa'i rigs// dngos 'byor bshams dang yid sprul dpag med pa// so sor gang la ci 'dod tshim byed pa'i// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// om̐ ā hūm̐/ mchod 'os skyabs kyi dam 333)pa dkon mchog gsum// rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rig 'dzin brda yi rgyud// gang zag snyan rgyud bka' gter bshad sgrub rgyud// dpal ldan rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas bdag cag skal ldan sgrub mchog la// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab nas kyang*// lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar mdzod// dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med zung 'jug rgyud// bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud sde'i lha// spyi dang bye brag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ 334) sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas bdag sogs mos pa'i bu rnams la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba dang*// rnam bzhi'i phrin las stsol med 'grub par mdzod// bar chad bsal mdzad ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// phyi nang gnas yul dud phrod la gnas pa'i// las dang ye shes ḍa ki'i tshogs rnams la// sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas rnal 'byor bsgrub mchog bdag cag gi /mi mthun nyera'atshe bar chad kun zhi zhing*// mchog thun 'dod dgu 'byung bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa bsrung mdzad chos skyong dam can tshogs// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas shing*// drag shugs stobs kyis gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag

335) cag 'khor bcas kyi// bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med bsgrub pa dang*// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol// gzhan yang rgyal ba padma thod phreng gis// dam la btags shing bka' bsgo gnyer gtad pa'i// bstan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig sogs// gnas srung gter srung yul lha gzhi bdag la// sman rag gtor tshogs= bzhes nas bdag cag gzhi byed gar gnas kyang*// ru nga phrag dog gdug rtsub kun zhi nas// chos mthun las kyi gdong grogs mdzad du gsol// srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal khams yan chad kyi// snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'gro pho mo'i tshogs// ris drug pha ma bgegs rigs lan chags sogs// snying rje'i yul gyur sems can thams cad la// 'dod yon longs spyod mchod sbyin rgya chen 'dis// ji ltar 'dod pa'i re ba skongs nas kyang*// 336) rang rang las kyi sdug bsngal kun zhi nas// bla med byang chub myur du thob gyur cig de ltar mchod sbyin rgya chen 'di bgyis mthus// 'jig rten khams kun bde skyid phun tshogs shing*// mtshon 'khrug nad yams mu ge kun zhi nas// 'gro kun 'dod dgu kun 'byung chos ldan shog /bye brag tu yang rgyal bstan rin po che// mi nub phyogs mthar khyab cing rgyas pa dang*// sde 'dzin skyes bu sku tshe phrin las 'phel/

/bstan 'gro'i don bzang rlabs chen 'byung bar shog /khyad par bdag sogs dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun bar chad dgra 'dre kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen chos ldan yid bzhin 'grub nas kyang*// mthar thug he ru ka dpal sar phyin shog gzhan yang bsngo smon 'dod gsol ci rigs byas kyang rung ngo*/ ༈ tshogs rdzogs sgrib gnyis ma lus byang ba dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug bar chad zhi ba'i phyir// gsang sngags nang gtor nyung ngur bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes dad ldan 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor// mkhas mchog padma legs grub stsal gyis sbyar// dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams kun// rim gnyis zab mo'i don la gnas byang shing*// don gnyis myur grub skuganyis mngon gyur shog
